title: `git push` (no args) fails with an upstream-mismatch error if the initial push used `HEAD:main` syntax on a differently-named local branch
summary: Pushing via `git push -u origin HEAD:main` sets up tracking in a way that later bare `git push` calls reject with "the upstream branch of your current branch does not match the name of your current branch." Name the local branch to match the remote branch first (e.g. `git checkout -B main`) so a plain `git push` afterward is unambiguous.
trigger: before scripting/automating `git push` calls (no explicit refspec) against a freshly-created repo or test fixture

title: Claude Code's available-skills list refreshes mid-session when a new SKILL.md file appears under ~/.claude/skills/ — no new session needed
summary: Writing a new skill file to the global skills directory made it immediately invokable in the *same*, already-running session — confirmed directly by a system reminder listing it right after the file was created. Useful when installing/updating a skill programmatically: no need to tell the user to restart their session just to pick it up.
